Amicable settlement of complaint AUH-2026-47102 failed despite employer's offer of AED 60,000 in instalments, so MOHRE referred the case to Abu Dhabi Labour Court on 28/09/2026 under Article 54, filed 08/10/2026. A handwritten note records a later verbal AED 85,000 offer rejected and first hearing on 10/11/2026."}
